$comment: Maps the raw Figma Variables export onto our token layers.
Collections are matched on the export's `name` field, never on filename, so re-exporting
with different filenames cannot silently drop a collection.
$neutralComment: The mode-name suffix in the shadcn/ui collection, NOT the ramp its light mode resolves
through. The modes are literally called 'light/slate' and 'dark/slate', but the light mode
aliases almost entirely through zinc (foreground -> zinc/950, muted -> zinc/100); only
'secondary' goes through slate. Renaming the modes in Figma would settle it — until then
this string has to match what the file says, not what the file does.
$themesComment: DARK ONLY, deliberately. The design is dark-only, so a light theme could only ever be
guesswork — and guessed values that nobody has looked at are worse than no values, because
The machinery is unchanged and light is one line away: add "light": "light/{neutral}" here,
restore the light halves in packages/tokens/src/semantic.ts, and regenerate. The shadcn/ui
collection in Figma still carries its light/slate mode untouched.

$layerComment.palette: 244 raw Tailwind colours. JS-only — emitting all of them would add ~12 kB of dead CSS to every consumer.
$layerComment.scale: Spacing, radius, opacity, container widths. Spacing and containers are emitted; the raw radius ramp is not (the contract layer owns radius).
$layerComment.type: Font families, sizes, line heights, weights. All emitted.
$layerComment.semantic: The shadcn/ui role vocabulary. Emitted per theme.
$layerComment.contract: The three radius knobs and two state opacities that Figma components actually bind to. Emitted using each variable's own codeSyntax expression where it has one.

$comment: Per-group rules. A leaf name is turned into a token name as:
key  = leaf starts with `strip` ? leaf without `strip` : leaf
A variable whose group has no rule here fails the build — see ignoredVariables.

renames.$comment: Known upstream typos and awkward names, fixed here rather than in the Figma file so the export stays a faithful copy.

ignoredVariables.$comment: Figma variables we deliberately do not emit. Anything NOT listed here and NOT mapped fails the build.
